note: Benton County Conservation recreation area on the Cedar River minutes from Vinton: 46 acres with a boat ramp, open-air shelter, playground and a wooded hiking loop. The electric sites sit in three small groups around a pond and the entrance road, behind the park road and a wooded riverbank. Hunting is allowed Sept 15 - May 15, not in the campground. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $16 electric / $10 non-electric, FCFS self-register, pit toilet, no showers, Apr 15-Oct 31. Added 30-amp and count 12 (9 electric + 3 primitive tent, 2025 county map). Waterfront lead riverview -> not waterfront: the sites are 55-85 m from the river behind the park road and the bank tree belt, the same layout as Benton City-Fry.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD riverview -> not waterfront (unsure rule, same measures as Benton City-Fry in p3-267). The 2025 county map puts the nine 30-amp sites in three groups. (a) Three beside 27th Avenue at the entrance, ~55-65 m from the Cedar, with the park road and a continuous wooded bank belt between (NAIP; leaf-off Esri shows the same belt; a parked RV visible at ~42.1638,-91.9764). (b) Three on the pond's NW side, ~60-85 m back, with the ramp's parking lanes and lot and scattered trees between. (c) Three on the pond loop's south side, ~150 m+ back and wooded. The county's photos show an open river view only from the ramp/parking area, not from a campsite. No source shows a campsite overlooking the river. Downgraded per the unsure rule.

SITES: MyCountyParks says '11 campsites (9 electric; 3 non electric)', which adds to 12. The 2025 county map draws 9 electric + 3 primitive tent sites, so the count is 12. The old note's '9 electric + 2 primitive' is superseded.
FEES: the county rules page is undated (2026 footer only); the rate matches the stored value.
SHOWERS false: neither page says 'no showers'; the pit toilet is the only restroom either page or the map lists, so false stands as before.
PIN OK (~20-80 m from the entrance group of sites). Website confirmed; the entry has no phone. The county office is (319) 472-4972 (rules page), if a phone is wanted.
FIT: no lengths posted; a parked RV is visible at an entrance site in the leaf-off imagery.
